metadata.title: Braided Multisections and Aspherical Stein Fillings
metadata.abstract: We construct Stein fillings diffeomorphic to complements of a connected symplectic unbranched multisection and a regular sphere fiber in the ruled surface $\Sigma_g\times S^2$. For every $g\geq2$ and every multisection degree $p\geq4$, a fixed contact three-manifold admits infinitely many pairwise nonhomeomorphic aspherical fillings of this form. Their first and second integral homology groups are $\Z^{2g}\oplus\Z/p$ and $\Z^{(2g-1)(p-1)}$, respectively, and their intersection pairings vanish. We vary the braid monodromy while preserving the marked contact boundary. Unbounded torsion orders in the first homology of regular unbranched covers of degree $p2^{p-1}$ detect infinitely many isomorphism types of fundamental groups. We also give an equivariant Weinstein handle construction for the cyclic filling $W_{g,4}$. The contact boundaries are supported by spinal open books with planar pages and have positive ordinary support genus.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 无限多非同胚Stein填充的构造
analysis.workSummary: 以Σ_g×S²中连通辛无分歧多截面和一个正则球纤维的补空间构造Stein填充。每个g≥2和多截面次数p≥4，对应某个固定接触三流形有无限多两两非同胚的非球面填充；H₁=Z^{2g}⊕Z/p、H₂=Z^{(2g−1)(p−1)}且交叉配对为零。改变编织单值但保持标记接触边界，以次数p·2^{p−1}的正则无分歧覆盖的一阶同调挠阶无界检测无限多基本群类型，并给循环W_{g,4}等变Weinstein手柄构造。
techniques: 固定标记接触边界的单值变形
有限覆盖同调挠群检测
analysis.breakthrough: 在相同边界及相同基础同调数据下，产生可由有限覆盖区分的无限多非球面填充。
analysis.limitations: 每组g,p固定一个边界，并非所有接触三流形；aspherical指高阶同伦群消失，不是球面边界。脊柱开书页平面不代表普通支撑亏格为零，本文反而为正。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
